mapper.sql: select ww.id, ww.short_id, ww.user_id, ww.supplier_id, ww.bank_card_json, ww.amount, ww.owner, ww.auditor, ww.completer, ww.remark, ww.status, ww.audit_time, ww.cancel_time, ww.complete_time, ww.tenant, ww.deleted, ww.create_by, ww.create_time, ww.update_by, ww.update_time from `withdraw` ww
mapper.insert: insert into `meattrade_withdraw` (id, short_id, user_id,user_name,user_phone, supplier_id,supplier_name,supplier_phone, bank_card_json, amount, owner, auditor, completer, remark, status, audit_time, cancel_time, complete_time, tenant, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{id}, #{shortId}, #{userId},#{userName},#{userPhone}, #{supplierId},#{supplierName},#{supplierPhone}, #{bankCardJson}, #{amount}, #{owner}, #{auditor}, #{completer}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{auditTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{completeTime}, #{tenant}, #{deleted}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update id = #{id}
mapper.update: update `meattrade_withdraw` ww set ww.status = 'PASSED', ww.auditor = #{operator}, ww.audit_time = #{datetime} where ww.id = #{id} and ww.status = 'AUDITING'

update `meattrade_withdraw` ww set ww.status = 'COMPLETED', ww.completer = #{operator}, ww.complete_time = #{datetime} where ww.id = #{id} and ww.status = 'PASSED' and ww.tenant = #{tenant}
